summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JTM 2.5/6)

data.turoyo: Qayšiwo i zəbdo, maḥtiwola ṭabʕan b hno l ruḥa.
data.translation: Sie schöpften die Butter ab und legten sie natürlich in ein eigenes (Gefäß).

rationale: New Infectum-wa box with explicit butter theme and customary production setting.

data.turoyo: B iḏoṯa gqayšo i zəbdo, yaʕni u məšḥo, i zəbdo, gmaləmola, gmašəġola w gəmmalḥola w gmaḥtola b səfoqo.
data.translation: Mit den Händen schöpft sie die Butter ab, sammelt sie, wäscht sie, salzt sie und legt sie in ein Gefäß.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell: explicit hand instrument and butter product.

data.turoyo: W kosaymi nuro taḥt ad daste, hul tuyo i kawetkaṯṯe, koqayši i kawetke w u ṭalp.
data.translation: Unter den Kesseln macht man Feuer an, bis Schaum entsteht. Den Schaum und den beim Kochen hochsteigenden. Hodensatz schöpft man ab.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell: foam and rising sediment; preserve the edition's punctuation and Hodensatz.

data.turoyo: Huwe kmasḥe i ḥoṯo, kqoyəš ḥwoṯa mə foṯe dam maye.
data.translation: und er badete sie und schöpfte wie sie vom Wasser ab.

rationale: Fifth Infectum example: masculine counterpart to the inherited feminine clause, with the manner comparison retained.

summary: The corpus supports one surface-removal meaning across substances. Butter is not a separate sense, and the inherited German abschöpfen already covers it.
The absent Infectum-wa box is attested by qayšiwo twice in JTM 2.5/6; one independent clause suffices. Infectum occurs in habitual procedures without -wa and in the alternating sibling-bathing tale.

Valency includes a zero-marked removed substance, source mə foṯe / me ʕal foṯe, and b iḏoṯa instrument. Omitted material in the masculine tale clause is recoverable from its explicit manner comparison.
The source may spell the Imperativ qəša where the inherited quote has quš-a; the same citation already exists, so no new form box or text correction is inferred.
Collate source qəša at 75/92 with inherited quš-a; vowel variation or transcription difference?
Confirm the PrS 83/30 and inherited prs 241/10 concordance. The feminine clause matches the latter exactly; PrS 83/11 has a different plural form.
Collate the printed German 'Hodensatz' and its punctuation at 94/134 before correcting edition text.
The skimmed material ranges from foam and algae to butter, silver/gold in a tale and rising sediment; the same surface-removal event is retained.
